retained.reason: The checked products consume Horizons VEC_TABLE=1 text as a pinned input. Astroquery 0.4.11 exposes parsed vectors or VEC_TABLE=3 text; changing this route requires migrating the pinned artifact and every receipt together. The complete existing route remains in one implementation.

retained.mechanic: PDS layouts not supported by pdr
retained.reason: The package boundary owns every product it successfully qualifies. Existing readers remain only for families such as the DART FITS-offset geometry cube that pdr 1.4.4 does not decode; no supported family has two production decoders.

Existing preparation consumers retain their CSPICE-checked evaluator until their pinned kernel and output receipts can migrate together. The tracked LSK/PCK time and frame oracle runs without the larger ignored DART kernel bank; the full DART oracle remains the geometry qualification. PlanetMapper exclusively owns SPICE geometry inside the telescope project route; results are not mixed between evaluators.

retained.mechanic: streaming FITS and in-process WCS reads
retained.reason: Existing in-process consumers retain subregion streaming, including repeated reads through an already open file handle. A tracked STIS image region agrees byte for byte with Astropy 8.0.1's memmap section; that one small fixture does not establish large-file memory or throughput superiority. Astropy owns scientific metadata qualification through science.mts; these consumers do not implement that qualification contract.

retained.mechanic: eclipse-map eigensolver and small positive-definite linear systems
retained.reason: The synchronous TypeScript fit and posterior sampler keep their small linear-algebra routines. The posterior now samples directly from the existing normal-matrix Cholesky factor instead of constructing and refactoring a full inverse. NumPy oracle fixtures check eigencurves, fitted coefficients and posterior covariance. A SciPy bridge would require a measured end-to-end gain and reproduction of the same deterministic and positivity behavior before replacing this route.

retained.mechanic: Spitzer archive discovery and byte retrieval
retained.reason: Astroquery IRSA did not complete the live spitzer_sha SIA query used to qualify this route. The proven implementation remains whole.
